item.text: `get_relevant_context` is currently pure symbolic: with a non-empty topic it searches the cache-coherent entity index via `entity_index.search_classes()` and returns structured `ContextItem` records, with no LLM on the retrieval path. If the topic is omitted or blank, it falls back to listing all ontology instances in the project KG via SPARQL quad iteration. I relied on the recorded entry `get_relevant_context: pure-symbolic context retrieval via entity index (topic) or list-all (no topic)`.
